title: Down at the Pool
note: b383 — the story title changed to 'Down at the Pool' but the picture is still the pond (per the brief). Dusk pages (7-9) need 'the pond at dusk', which the 'dusk' backdrop does not draw (only 'pond_day' has a pond) — a large water-toned 'puddle' prop plus 'reeds' stands in for the pond surface instead.

pages.brief: Ned walking down a grassy slope towards the pond in the early morning, dew on everything, his tracks behind him in the wet grass.
pages.alt: Ned walks down a dewy grassy slope towards the pond in the early morning, his tracks showing behind him in the wet grass.

pages.brief: The sun clearing the hedge, its light spreading across the pond surface in a bright path. Ned a small silhouette at the water's edge.
pages.alt: The sun clears the hedge and spreads a bright path of light across the pond surface, with Ned a small silhouette at the water's edge.

pages.brief: Ned with his head cocked, listening, and a cow visible over the hedge in the middle distance, its head raised. Quiet rural morning.
pages.alt: Ned stands with his head cocked, listening, while a cow raises its head over the hedge in the middle distance on a quiet rural morning.

pages.brief: Close on dark soil with a small round coin half buried, one bright edge catching the sun. Ned's beak reaching towards it.
pages.alt: Close on dark soil, a small round coin lies half buried with one bright edge catching the sun, as Ned's beak reaches towards it.

pages.brief: Two hens picking about together on the bank, drawn as a pair, comic and busy. Ned watching them with interest.
pages.alt: A pair of hens pick busily about together on the bank, while Ned watches them with interest.

pages.brief: Olive the owl perched with great dignity on the back of an old wooden chair left out by the pond. Absurd and stately.
pages.alt: Olive the owl perches with great dignity on the back of an old wooden chair left out beside the pond.

pages.brief: Wide dusk view of the pond going pink and grey, reeds black against the water, everything settling for the night.
pages.alt: A wide dusk view of the pond turning pink and grey, with reeds standing black against the water as everything settles for the night.

pages.brief: Ned turning away from the water to head home, one last look back over his shoulder. Small figure, big landscape.
pages.alt: Ned turns away from the water to head home, pausing for one last look back over his shoulder, small against the big landscape.

pages.brief: Closing page: Olive on the chair and Ned walking off up the slope, both waving. Warm last light on the pond behind them.
pages.alt: Closing page: Olive waves from the chair and Ned waves back as he walks off up the slope, warm last light glowing on the pond behind them.
